# Crop-cut farm polygons with crop type and yield for Zambia (ECAAS Bird's-Eye)

Zambia (ECAAS crop cuts) field boundaries (2022) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Pula Advisors. License: GPL-2.0-or-later.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/zm_ecaas/latest/zm_ecaas.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/zm_ecaas/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: yield, id, crop:code, admin_level_1, crop_condition, intercrop, harvest_weight, harvest_date, hcat:name_en, intercropped, geometry, planting_date, metrics:area, crop:name, admin_level_2, hcat:name, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/zm_ecaas/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/zm_ecaas/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/zm_ecaas/collection.json
